configurations._comment: Port moved 5180 -> 8080 by request (2026-08-24). NOTE: 5180 is the origin registered on the Google OAuth client, so a real Google Sign-In will be refused on 8080 until http://localhost:8080 is added to that client's Authorised JavaScript origins. Local development is unaffected today because public/config.local.json leaves googleClientId blank. --strictPort makes a busy 8080 fail loudly instead of silently landing on another port.
